en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large historicist town hall dominating the scene. The building has a tall clock tower with an onion-shaped dome, stepped gables, and many windows. In front of it, people walk across a cobbled square where small carts and market stalls are set up; a dog is visible in the foreground. The image has wide white margins typical of an old photographic postcard. No visible printed caption or handwritten text can be seen on the front.
